sloka: एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता ।स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः ॥२-२९-२३॥
transliteration: evam uktā tu sā cintām maithilī samupāgatā ।snāpayantī iva gām uṣṇaiḥ aśrubhir nayana cyutaiḥ ॥2-29-23॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.
